seller_trust.page.title: Seller trust score
seller_trust.hero.title: What is a trust score?
seller_trust.hero.p1: A future 0–100 signal that combines several behavioral hints so buyers can understand seller reliability — it never replaces your own judgment or direct communication.
seller_trust.hero.p2: Why it builds trust: it reduces uncertainty for newer accounts and aligns expectations on quality and commitment once officially launched.
seller_trust.hero.p3: The system is coming later — what you see here is product preparation, not live activation.
seller_trust.hero.p4: Important: no points are calculated for your account right now; anything shown is a design preview only, not a real score.

legal.terms.title: Terms & Conditions
legal.terms.intro_body: By using Souq Al Arab EU, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal.terms.usage_body: You may use the platform only for lawful purposes and in compliance with local laws and platform policies.
legal.terms.account_body: You are responsible for your login credentials and all activity under your account, and you must keep your information accurate.
legal.terms.content_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of posted content, which must not be misleading, unlawful, or infringing others' rights.
legal.terms.transactions_body: The platform connects users. Buyers and sellers are responsible for arranging payment and delivery safely.
legal.terms.prohibited_body: Illegal, fraudulent, abusive, or policy-violating content is prohibited and may be removed without prior notice.
legal.terms.liability_body: We make reasonable efforts to keep the service reliable, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation at all times.
legal.terms.updates_body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised terms.
legal.terms.contact_body: For legal questions or complaints, please contact us through the in-app support channels.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro_body: We respect your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use the platform.
legal.privacy.collected_body: We may collect basic account data, contact information, content you post, and technical usage data.
legal.privacy.usage_body: We use data to operate the platform, improve services, provide support, and deliver a safer experience.
legal.privacy.sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data. Limited data may be shared when needed to run the service or meet legal obligations.
legal.privacy.security_body: We apply reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access or misuse.
legal.privacy.cookies_body: We may use cookies to improve performance, remember preferences, and analyze platform usage.
legal.privacy.retention_body: We retain data as long as necessary for operational or legal purposes, then delete or anonymize it according to policy.
legal.privacy.rights_body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data within applicable legal limits.
legal.privacy.contact_body: For privacy-related questions, contact us through the Help & Support page in the app.

verification_preview.hero.title: Why verification matters
verification_preview.hero.lead: We plan to connect identity and business activity to your account with clear policies—to increase trust between buyers and sellers, reduce fraud, and improve credibility for active accounts.
verification_preview.hero.point_trust: Higher trust between buyers and sellers with clearer identity signals.
verification_preview.hero.point_safety: Better protection for users and fewer misleading accounts.
verification_preview.hero.point_credibil: Stronger credibility and the option to highlight trusted accounts later.
verification_preview.notice.title: In preparation
verification_preview.notice.body: Advanced verification will roll out later. This page does not accept real submissions or documents yet, and no files are uploaded or stored.
verification_preview.type.identity.title: Identity verification
verification_preview.type.identity.desc: Linking personal identity to the account under future, explicit requirements.
verification_preview.type.seller.title: Seller verification
verification_preview.type.seller.desc: Highlighting seller accounts with stronger readiness signals when criteria exist.
verification_preview.type.business.title: Shop / company verification
verification_preview.type.business.desc: Proving the business entity for stores and non-individual activity.
verification_preview.type.phone.title: Phone verification (future)
verification_preview.type.phone.desc: Will complement in-app communication with an extra protection layer later.
verification_preview.type.email.title: Email verification
verification_preview.type.email.desc: Email ownership confirmation is already available under Settings → Email; advanced verification here will extend that path later without duplicating the same step.
verification_preview.benefit.badge.title: “Verified” badge
verification_preview.benefit.badge.desc: May appear on profile or listings according to future rules.
verification_preview.benefit.trust.title: Higher trust
verification_preview.benefit.trust.desc: Clearer identity reduces hesitation around offers and pricing.
Trusted accounts may be highlighted in the marketplace when criteria are ready.
verification_preview.benefit.fraud.title: Less fraud
verification_preview.benefit.fraud.desc: Raises the cost of impersonation and throwaway accounts with an extra check.
verification_preview.benefit.seller_trus: Complements the seller trust journey and other quality signals in the platform.
verification_preview.cta_footnote: Button is intentionally disabled — no request is sent and no files are uploaded.
